svg.title: Vale documents an out-of-scope school placement and demands a contestable route.
svg.desc: Beside the laboratory's single shared kit, the penalty-bearing fixed career track remains active. Vale records the scope breach and a required contestable-route design for the hearing; more undeclared service links remain visible behind the pupil profile.
svg.text: Page 39, panel 4 · Quiet three-shot beside the laboratory doorway

text.tspan: Vale documents that the linkage exceeds the stated
trial and demands a contestable route, but leaves
the active placement unchanged for the public
